Jodi L Kinney, DC at Intrinsic Chiropractic Center and Kinney Chiropractic, is a committed and compassionate Chiropractor serving the Belmar Shore area specializing in Chiropractic Care and Family Wellness. Dr. Jodi strives to provide pain relief for many symptoms and conditions, and keep you healthy so that you can have a higher quality of life. Don't just take our word for it though; visit our testimonials page to see what our patients have to say.

At our Chiropractic Offices, you will receive the best care through the use of modern chiropractic techniques and technology. Dr. Jodi Kinney and the staff at Intrinsic Chiropractic Center and Kinney Chiropractic have a genuine concern for your well-being and health! Call us today and we can develop a chiropractic plan specific for you.

Phone: (732) 894-3333
Belmar Address: 1600 #A Highway 71 Belmar, NJ 07719.
Jackson Address: 100 W Veterans Hwy, Jackson Township, NJ 08527
